theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: Small Steps, Powerful Growth Over Time
body: Regular investments help you buy more units when prices fall, fewer when high. Over time, this averages your cost and harnesses compounding's strength.
caption: Consistent investing through market cycles can amplify your wealth gradually. Starting early maximizes the benefit of time in the market. #SIPFundamentals #CompoundingPower #RupeeCostAveraging #InvestSmart #WealthBuilding
